info.title: Holo Folder API
info.description: Premium/lifetime data API. MCP uses OAuth separately. Card image fields are R2-only.

post.description:
Reconcile the raw (ungraded) contents of one existing collection in place: same slot IDs, no manifest, settings or grid change. Send version 4 with the exact current copied manifest, per-slot origins and slotOrder.before/after (identical, or a permutation that also advances the layout revision), plus the exact item, slot, placement, content and layout versions you reviewed. Released copies go to Unassigned; copies placed in other collections cannot move. Does not acquire copies, replace metadata, touch graded copies or restore settings, assets or CSV. Limits: 1025 slots, 2050 raw copies, 100 wants per slot, 1.75 MiB command; oversized requests return invalid_input. A committed rejection returns REST 409 storage_restore_rejected (MCP: isError) with error.rejection; retrying the same request replays the stored outcome. Other conflicts, cancellation and failed commits leave the outcome unknown: keep the original request and do a fresh full read before reconciling. outputSchema covers accepted receipts; errors are in _meta holofolder.com/errorSchemas.

Required permissions: `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `restore_raw_collection_content`.

409.description: Only the bound terminal ledger rejection carries proof; ordinary conflicts do not.

message.const: The original restore did not commit. Read current storage before explicit reconciliation.

post.description:
A committed rejection returns REST 409 storage_creation_rejected or storage_import_rejected (MCP: isError) with error.rejection {outcome, operationId, code, inventoryRevision}; retrying the same request replays the stored outcome. Other errors (conflicts, billing, cancellation, network) leave the outcome unknown: keep the original request and do a fresh full read before reconciling. outputSchema covers accepted receipts; errors are in _meta holofolder.com/errorSchemas. Arrange copies into an empty or target-only native collection whose copied manifest already matches (JSON v2). Every copy needs an explicit add or a versioned move of an existing copy. Does not replace collections or configuration, import assets, restore changed snapshots or reuse backup IDs.

Required permissions: `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `import_storage_arrangement`.

post.description:
A committed rejection returns REST 409 storage_command_rejected (MCP: isError) with error.rejection {outcome, operationId, code, inventoryRevision}; other conflicts and timeouts leave the outcome unknown, so do a fresh full read before reconciling. outputSchema covers accepted receipts; errors are in _meta holofolder.com/errorSchemas. Atomic slot commands by stable ID: create, move, clear, remove, update (target and wants) and layout (the rows × columns grid; prefer set_binder_layout, which previews it). Needs exact inventory, collection, layout and slot/item/placement revisions plus a retry-stable operationId. Clear and remove release copies to Unassigned and never delete ownership. Use privateFields=preserve for create, reorder and target-only updates to keep hidden wants; omitted or replace keeps full-replacement semantics.

Required permissions: `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `execute_slot_commands`.

privateFields.description: preserve allows public patchGrading and exact selected-want expectedPublic; rejects full grading/wants replacement and slot/collection removal. replace (also the legacy default when omitted) retains full-replacement semantics; never rebuild replacements from redacted reads.

expectedOwnerUserId.description: Recipient precondition, required with privateFields=preserve. Must match the current authenticated owner scope; never selects or grants authority. Retain across retries.

post.description:
A committed rejection returns REST 409 storage_command_rejected (MCP: isError) with error.rejection {outcome, operationId, code, inventoryRevision}; other conflicts and timeouts leave the outcome unknown, so do a fresh full read before reconciling. outputSchema covers accepted receipts; errors are in _meta holofolder.com/errorSchemas. Atomic batch of owned-copy commands: insertAssign, add, edit, setFinish, patchGrading, removeOwned, unassign, assign, move, removeSlots and deleteCollection, each with exact revision preconditions for the copies and destinations it touches, plus a retry-stable operationId. insertAssign creates one slot before an existing slot (before:null appends); selection:null creates no ownership, existing takes an exact Unassigned item version and new creates the item. Nothing auto-selects a grade or moves an assigned copy. Only removeOwned (the command, or removeOwned:true on deleteCollection, which deletes raw copies there and leaves graded ones Unassigned) deletes ownership. setFinish must still match its pocket's target; patchGrading changes only the fields it names. Use privateFields=preserve for add, removeOwned, unassign and placements with fulfillWant:null to keep hidden certificates, assets and unrelated wants; omitted or replace keeps full-replacement semantics. Limits: 100 commands, 256 selected entities, 4096 slots, 256 KiB request, 10 s.

Required permissions: `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `execute_inventory_commands`.

privateFields.description: preserve allows public patchGrading and exact selected-want expectedPublic; rejects full grading/wants replacement and slot/collection removal. replace (also the legacy default when omitted) retains full-replacement semantics; never rebuild replacements from redacted reads.

expectedOwnerUserId.description: Recipient precondition, required with privateFields=preserve. Must match the current authenticated owner scope; never selects or grants authority. Retain across retries.

Other errors (conflicts, billing, cancellation, network) leave the outcome unknown: keep the original request and do a fresh full read before reconciling. outputSchema covers accepted receipts; errors are in _meta holofolder.com/errorSchemas. Atomically create a native collection from an ordered copied manifest (see preview_storage_preset), optionally with manifest.setScope: the reviewed language, verified finishes, promos, exclusions, coverage warnings and capture time. Catalog eligibility is checked only at creation; goals stay editable and free slots can be appended later. Keep the collection, slot and operation IDs across retries. Empty goals and spacers create no ownership or wants.

Required permissions: `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `create_storage_collection`.

post.description:
Preview undoing an Activity event. Unsupported events return conflicts or unsupported with no usable plan. Undoing a default collection’s creation needs preview_storage_recovery_v2 with a replacement.

Required permissions: `collection:read`, `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `preview_storage_recovery`.

Only recovery_plan_conflict and recovery_dependency_conflict are terminal: REST 409 storage_recovery_rejected (MCP: isError) with error.rejection {outcome, operationId, code, inventoryRevision}. Retrying the same request replays the stored outcome. Status, billing errors and cancellation prove nothing; after a rejection, re-read and preview again with a new operationId. outputSchema covers accepted receipts; errors are in _meta holofolder.com/errorSchemas. Apply a reviewed version-1 recovery from preview_storage_recovery with confirmation, its planToken and a retry-stable operationId. Changes since the preview are rejected.

Required permissions: `collection:read`, `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `apply_storage_recovery`.

Status, billing errors and cancellation prove nothing; after a rejection, re-read and preview again with a new operationId. outputSchema covers accepted receipts; errors are in _meta holofolder.com/errorSchemas. Preview the ordered manifest a preset would create, without saving anything. Use version 1, with speciesIds only for selected-species or printings only for selected-printings. post.description:
Identify a card from a photo. Send the picture as base64 (JPEG, PNG or WebP, at most 3 MB; a card cropped to about 500-1000 px works best), optionally with the name and collector number you read from it. Returns the closest cards by picture, most similar first, with a confidence label. It never picks a card for you: confidence is "confirmed" only when your number and set total agree with one of the top five candidates and no other agrees as well, which is then marked confirmed. language limits the search to that print language's pictures (Japanese prints have their own; other languages share the English picture). Limited to 20 requests per minute per API key or connection.

Required permissions: `catalog:read`. MCP tool: `identify_card`.

image.description: The photo, base64 (a data: URL prefix is allowed).

name.description: The card name as read, e.g. "Charizard ex".

number.description: The collector number as printed, e.g. "025/165" or "TG05".

includeDetails.description: Include details (the stored provider record). Default: true on REST, false on MCP.

model.description: The picture model the fingerprints come from.

confidence.description: confirmed: the number and set total hints agree with one of the top five candidates, and no other agrees as well. Otherwise the picture alone: high and medium were right about 92% and 86% of the time for the first candidate on real binder photos; low means choose from the list. none: no candidates.

patch.description:
Change a binder’s page grid (rows × columns, 1–8 each; grids other than 1×1, 2×2, 3×3, 3×4, 4×3 and 4×4 need Premium). Pockets are an ordered list paged by the grid, so no card leaves its pocket and nothing is removed: cards keep their order and only move between pages and spots. Send dryRun:true first to get the consequences (cards changing page or spot, page counts, plain-language summary) and the preconditions, then apply with those preconditions and a retry-stable operationId. A retry with the same body returns the stored receipt; anything that changed in between returns 409 to review again. Recorded in Activity and undoable.

Required permissions: `collection:read`, `binders:read`, `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `set_binder_layout`.

dryRun.description: true reviews the change and returns preconditions without changing anything.

operationId.description: Required to apply. Keep it across retries.

inventoryRevision.description: Required to apply, from the dry run.

collectionVersion.description: Required to apply, from the dry run.

layoutRevision.description: Required to apply: the binder’s current layout revision, from the dry run.

post.description:
Move a whole page of a binder to another page number, like Move page in the app’s layout editing: page `from` becomes page `to` and the pages in between shift by one. Pages are one-based and paged by the binder’s grid (list_binders). Only full pages move: a partial last page, or moving past one, returns 400 page_not_movable. Cards keep their pockets; only pocket order changes. Send a retry-stable operationId; a retry with the same body returns the stored receipt, and a change by someone else mid-request returns 409 to try again with a new operationId. Recorded in Activity and undoable.

Required permissions: `collection:read`, `binders:read`, `collection:write`, `binders:write`. MCP tool: `move_binder_page`.

to.description: The page number it should become, one-based.

operationId.description: Retry-stable: keep it across retries of this move.
